title: Introduce encrypted-audit-proofs and region-bound operator clamp for KMS usage
author: Ethan Morales
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated geographies have asked for stronger non-repudiation guarantees for audit events related to key usage and operator actions, plus a simple, enforceable operator-region constraint to prevent accidental cross-region KMS calls. This PR introduces two coordinated features: (1) encrypted audit proofs: audit events that include a compact, verifiable encrypted payload signed by an internal audit key and optionally wrapped with the tenant's CMK fingerprint; (2) operator-region clamp: an RBACv2 extension and runtime gate that forces operator-scoped service credentials to be constrained to a configured region set and enforces a KMS usage allowlist per-operator. The change set touches the audit pipeline (encryption/signing), the KMS client allocation path, the RBAC decision layer, and the admin UI flags used by installers and private deployments. Compatibility: defaults are additive and disabled for older clusters unless a cluster feature flag is set (security.encrypted_audit_proofs=true). Rollout plan: staged rollout with canary on Dedicated then Private installs, with a dry-run selector that emits a non-fatal metric when region violations would have occurred. Related: builds on earlier residency and KMS affinity work (ENG-6742), and ties into incident-runbooks for operator misrouting (SUP-1294).
commit_summary: commit 1: add audit/encryptor package, AES-GCM envelope + signature proof; commit 2: extend audit schema with proof_v1 and cmk_fingerprint; commit 3: implement operator-region clamp in rbacv2 authorizer with policy predicates and tooling; commit 4: KMS allocator allowlist and region-check integration; commit 5: add e2e tests and migration task; commit 6: docs and console flags; commit 7: fix race in async audit flush under high throughput

release_notes:
- Add encrypted audit proofs (proof_v1) to audit pipeline: signed, AES-GCM-wrapped payloads for KMS operations and operator actions.
- RBACv2 operator-region clamp: enforce operator-scoped credentials to configured region sets and per-operator KMS allowlist.
- Admin/installer flag: security.encrypted_audit_proofs=false by default for existing clusters.
- Migration helper: rewrap-existing-audit-batches CLI to attach proofs to historical events.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag security.encrypted_audit_proofs to turn on proof generation. To prevent alert storms, run in dry-run mode for 72 hours (helm values.security.encryptedAudit.dry_run=true) and monitor metric audit.proof.enforcement_violations. If you use Private installer, ensure the installer-provided KMS key fingerprint is configured via deploy/helm/values.security.yaml: audit.cmkFingerprint. There is a lightweight migration tool bundled at tools/audit-rewrap; it runs offline and requires a maintenance window for very large clusters.
security_considerations:
- Private key for signing audit proofs is stored in the cluster keystore; for Private deployments operators should optionally configure an HSM/KMS-backed signing key (installer guides updated).
- Proof construction avoids including PII in the envelope; payloads include event_id, timestamp, actor_claim_hash, cmk_fingerprint (optional).
- Crypto review completed and documented in SECURITY-2025-11-05; we intentionally avoided complex compression to limit side-channel risk.
- RBAC changes add policy predicates; default policies deny cross-region operator KMS calls unless explicitly allowed.
qa_steps: 1) Deploy with feature flag off and smoke test: ensure no changes to default audit output. 2) Enable feature flag in dry-run and generate representative KMS calls; assert metrics audit.proof.dryrun_violation > 0 but no enforcement. 3) Flip enforcement on for a single canary operator and verify KMS calls outside allowed regions are blocked and a single enforcement metric is emitted. 4) Run rewrap tool on a small audit batch and validate proof verification tool accepts rewrapped entries. 5) Run e2e test suite under high-throughput to validate async audit flush race fix.
